asset_findings.evidence_notes: Inspected annual chart pixels. BLS first readings: headline 2.6 to 3.7, core 3.3 to 2.6 percent; October 2025 gap is visible, zero baseline and endpoint labels agree with source-bound series.
Inspected monthly chart pixels. September headline 0.6 and core 0.3 percent, SA basis; October-November 2025 gaps are preserved, zero line and negative observations are visible.
Inspected effects chart pixels. Energy +0.377, core +0.265 and food +0.006 percentage points; disjoint BLS Table 6 categories, common zero baseline, labels and units match.
Inspected exact USDA photograph of dry beans on supermarket shelves. Archive June 2023 context, USDA creator/public-domain evidence and credit are retained; no September 2026 observation is implied.
